changelog: Shotgun (beta): Kraken 2 confidence now defaults to 0 (Kraken 2's own default). With 0.1 the mock test failed on nextapp — whole species lost on Illumina and almost every Nanopore read unclassified with the 16 GB index; with 0 the same mock passes on the real Standard-08 index (genus Bray-Curtis 0.039 Illumina, 0.019 Nanopore). The index is read from disk automatically when it does not fit in free memory. setup_shotgun.sh found no tools on machines whose `mamba info --base` prints a label before the path (mamba 2); fixed. Backend restart required.

previous.changelog: Shotgun metagenome pipeline (beta): new menu entry, Illumina pairs or Oxford Nanopore reads; fastp / chopper QC, optional host removal with Hostile (human, mouse or a genome FASTA), Kraken 2 + Bracken species abundance, tables in the amplicon layout so composition, diversity, Controls and MaAsLin 3 work, and its own report. Separate script, conda env (ngamp-meta, setup_shotgun.sh) and index folder; nothing the amplicon or WGS pipelines use was changed in behaviour. Licence bit 9 'Shotgun' (dev machines: open). tests/run_shotgun_mock.sh checks it end to end. Experimental: build_16s_typestrain_db.py makes a 16S reference from every 16S copy of the type-strain genomes, for Emu and DADA2; evaluated against Emu default and SILVA 138.2 it was not better (see the script header), so the existing databases stay the default. ONT WGS: the app showed '0 genomes' for type strains downloaded by v2.18.1. Backend restart required (license.py changed: restart right after the update).
